title: 第一卷 第1章 真憋屈啊第一卷 第2章 铁舔狗啊
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 简陋木床上，曹阳面色苍白，脸颊凹陷，直愣愣地看着身侧的清冷仙子。
“祝缨师姐……可以了吗？”缓了好一会儿，才开口说道。
祝缨思索片刻，朱唇轻启，“还差一次。”
她的声音很好听，就像山间的清泉，凉爽又纯净。
不过，曹阳却是面色大变，“让我休息一会儿吧！”
“聒噪。”
祝缨冷声开口，玉手一挥。
曹阳眼睛猛地瞪大。
还没等他喊出救命，嘴巴已经说不出话来了。
屋内温度骤升，曹阳只觉得天旋地转，体内的气血顺着经脉疯狂上涌。
这是《姹女夺天功》的霸道之处。
这种功法十分邪门，祝缨用曹阳提升修为，用以滋养自身灵脉。
“要死要死要死！”曹阳在心里狂吼。
你一个正道内门仙子，非得修这种邪功吗？
足足半个时辰后。
曹阳看着房顶，怔怔无神。
祝缨瞥了他一眼，“你虽是五行杂灵根，体质低劣，但这十八年未经人事的元阳倒也出奇的纯粹，算你运气好，我也是初次采补，便宜你了。”
说罢，她随手从储物袋里摸出三块下品灵石，随手扔在床头。
“别对任何人提起我来过，否则……”
话没说完，眼前的祝缨便已经消失。
“我不亏？”曹阳仰面朝天，骂娘的心都有了。
老子连命都快搭进去了，你拿三块灵石打发叫花子呢？
他在木板床上足足缓了一个时辰，才勉强攒起一点力气，靠着墙壁坐了起来。
看着头顶漏风的茅草屋顶，曹阳满脸苦涩。
胎穿到这个修仙世界整整十八年了。
原本以为能像其他穿越的主角一样，一路开挂，脚踢各路天骄，怀抱圣女仙子。
结果现实给了他一记响亮的耳光。
五行杂灵根的他只能被扔到废丹房来，处理丹药残渣，长期被丹毒侵蚀身体。
在这里待着，就相当于每天都在慢性服毒，活过三十岁的都寥寥无几。
曹阳卡在炼气一层整整三年，寸步难进。
每天还要干着最脏最累的活，受尽欺压。
要不是祝缨修炼邪功，为了掩人耳目，急需找一个死了也没人查的炉鼎，他这辈子连内门女弟子的背影都看不到。
“不过……这三天三夜，倒也没白干。”
曹阳深吸一口气，闭上眼睛。
一片虚无中，一尊古朴的青铜小鼎正静静悬浮。
content_en:
On the simple wooden bed, Cao Yang's face was pale and his cheeks were sunken, staring blankly at the cold fairy beside him.
"Senior Sister Zhu Ying...is it okay?" He waited for a while before speaking.
Zhu Ying thought for a moment, then opened her red lips and said, "One more time."
Her voice is beautiful, like a clear spring in the mountains, cool and pure.
However, Cao Yang's expression changed drastically, "Let me rest for a while!"
"Noisy."
Zhu Ying spoke coldly and waved her jade hand.
Cao Yang's eyes widened suddenly.
Before he could shout for help, he was already speechless.
The temperature in the room rose sharply, and Cao Yang felt like the world was spinning, and the energy and blood in his body surged crazily along his meridians.
This is the domineering aspect of "Girls Seize Heaven".
This kind of technique is very evil. Zhu Ying uses Cao Yang to improve his cultivation and nourish his own spiritual veins.
"Death, death, death!" Cao Yang roared in his heart.
You, a righteous inner sect fairy, must practice such evil skills?
A full half hour later.
Cao Yang looked at the roof, stunned.
Zhu Ying glanced at him and said, "Although you have mixed spiritual roots of the Five Elements and a poor constitution, Yuanyang, who has not been used by anyone in the past eighteen years, is surprisingly pure. You are lucky. It is my first time to take supplements, so I will give you an advantage."
After saying that, she casually took out three low-grade spiritual stones from her storage bag and threw them on the bedside.
"Don't mention to anyone that I've been here, otherwise..."
Before he finished speaking, Zhu Ying disappeared in front of him.
"Am I not at a loss?" Cao Yang turned his head to the sky and wanted to curse his mother.
I'm almost risking my life, why are you sending the beggar away with three spiritual stones?
He rested on the wooden bed for a full hour before he managed to gather some strength and sat up against the wall.
Looking at the leaky thatched roof above his head, Cao Yang felt bitter.
It has been eighteen years since I was born in this world of immortality.
I originally thought I could be like other time-traveling protagonists, cheating all the way, kicking all the geniuses, and embracing saints and fairies.
As a result, reality gave him a loud slap in the face.
With five elements and mixed spiritual roots, he could only be thrown into the waste elixir room to deal with the elixir residues, and his body was corroded by erysipelas for a long time.
Staying here is equivalent to chronically taking poison every day, and very few people survive past thirty.
Cao Yang was stuck at the first level of Qi Refining for three whole years, unable to make any progress.
They have to do the dirtiest and most tiring work every day and suffer all kinds of oppression.
If Zhu Ying hadn't practiced evil skills and urgently needed to find a furnace cauldron that was dead and no one would investigate in order to hide it from others, he would never have been able to see the back of a female inner sect disciple in his life.
"But...these three days and three nights have not been in vain."
Cao Yang took a deep breath and closed his eyes.
In the midst of nothingness, a simple bronze cauldron was floating quietly.
